goals: Verify the encryption module correctly implements encrypt, decrypt, and reEncrypt operations
Verify the correct interaction with WIF and BIP38 libraries for key processing
activities: Mock wif.decode to return private key object
Mock bip38.encrypt to return encrypted key
Call encryption.encrypt with value and passphrase
Verify wif.decode was called with value
Verify bip38.encrypt was called with privateKey, true, passphrase, and options
Verify encryption.encrypt returns encryptedKey
Mock bip38.decrypt to return private key object
Mock wif.encode to return decrypted value
Call encryption.decrypt with value and passphrase
Verify bip38.decrypt was called with value, passphrase, and options
Verify wif.encode was called with 0x80, privateKey, and true
Verify encryption.decrypt returns decryptedValue
Spy on encryption.encrypt method
Spy on encryption.decrypt method
Mock encryption.encrypt return value
Mock encryption.decrypt return value
Call encryption.reEncrypt with encryptedValue, currentPassphrase, and newPassphrase
Verify decryptSpy was called with encryptedValue and currentPassphrase
Verify encryptSpy was called with decryptedValue and newPassphrase
Verify encryption.reEncrypt returns newEncryptedValue
Clear encryption.encrypt spy
Clear encryption.decrypt spy
